acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: Why keep a vegetable bed to 1-1.2m wide rather than wider?
acceptedRows.currentTarget: Ndi ngani ni tshi vhulunga vegetable bed i tshi vha 1-1.2m wide, nṱhani ha u i ita wider?
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Ndi ngani ni tshi vhulunga bed ya miroho i na vhuphara ha 1-1.2m, nṱhani ha u i ita yo aṱamaho?
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: Why keep a vegetable bed at width1-1.2m rather than make it wide?
acceptedRows.reason: yo aṱamaho states wide; the wider comparison is no longer explicit. Preserve wider rather than invent a comparative.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Ndi ngani ni tshi vhulunga bed ya miroho i na vhuphara ha 1-1.2m, nṱhani ha u i ita wider?
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: You can reach the centre from either side without stepping on the growing area, avoiding compaction
acceptedRows.currentTarget: Ni nga swikelela vhukati ni tshi bva kha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa masia mavhili ni sa kande growing area, na thivhela compaction
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Ni nga swikelela vhukati ni tshi bva kha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa masia mavhili ni sa kande fhethu hune zwimela zwa mela, na thivhela compaction.
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: You can reach the middle from either of the two sides without stepping where crops grow, preventing compaction.
acceptedRows.reason: Either side, can, without stepping and compaction remain. Ordinary growing-area framing is defensible.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Ni nga swikelela vhukati ni tshi bva kha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa masia mavhili ni sa kande fhethu hune zwimela zwa mela, na thivhela compaction.
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: When can nitrogen in bean crop residues become available to other plants?
acceptedRows.currentTarget: Ndi lini nitrogen in bean crop residues i nga vha available kha other plants?
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Ndi lini nitrogen ya bean crop residues ine ya nga vha available kha zwimela zwiṅwe?
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: When nitrogen of bean residues which can be available to other plants?
acceptedRows.reason: Relative ine weakens the direct can-become question and available remains technical. Restore question construction and retain become available as exact technical English.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Ndi lini nitrogen in bean crop residues i nga become available kha zwimela zwiṅwe?
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: As soil organisms decompose the residues
acceptedRows.currentTarget: As soil organisms decompose the residues
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Musi soil organisms dzi tshi decompose residues.
acceptedRows.reason: Musi ... dzi tshi preserves the contemporaneous as process; decompose remains technical. No early/immediate release added.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Musi soil organisms dzi tshi decompose residues.
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: Only when pumpkin leaves shade them
acceptedRows.currentTarget: Only musi maṱari a pumpkin a tshi ita murunzi kha them.
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Feela musi maṱari a pumpkin a tshi ita murunzi kha residues.
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: Only when pumpkin leaves shade residues.
acceptedRows.reason: Feela is a Sesotho-form intrusion into Tshivenda; explicitly replacing ambiguous them with residues adds an interpretation. Use existing Tshivenda fhedzi and retain source pronoun.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Fhedzi musi maṱari a pumpkin a tshi ita murunzi kha them.
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: Beans fix nitrogen with suitable root bacteria. Nitrogen in their residues is released through decomposition; growing beans beside maize does not guarantee immediate feeding.
acceptedRows.currentTarget: Beans fix nitrogen with suitable root bacteria. Nitrogen in their residues is released through decomposition; growing beans beside maize does not guarantee immediate feeding.
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Beans fix nitrogen with suitable root bacteria. Nitrogen in their residues is released through decomposition; u alusa beans tsini na maize a zwi khwaṱhisi immediate feeding.
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: Exact nitrogen-fixation and decomposition clauses; growing beans near maize does not strengthen/confirm immediate feeding.
acceptedRows.reason: Khwaṱhisi is not an independently established guarantee equivalent. Translate growing-beside framing but retain exact negated guarantee predicate.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Beans fix nitrogen with suitable root bacteria. Nitrogen in their residues is released through decomposition; u alusa beans tsini na maize does not guarantee immediate feeding.
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.currentTarget: Varieties dza open-pollinated dzi bveledza khaṋo nnzhi u fhira
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Varieties dza open-pollinated dzi bveledza khaṋo nnzhi.
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: Open-pollinated varieties produce a large/many harvest.
acceptedRows.reason: Removing dangling u fhira leaves an absolute many, losing source comparative more. Keep exact yield more.
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: Amadumbe actually prefers damper ground where maize would struggle — it fills a niche other staples can't handle well.
acceptedRows.currentTarget: Amadumbe actually prefers damper ground where maize would struggle — it fills a niche other staples can't handle well.
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Amadumbe i funa vhukuma damper ground, hune maize ya konḓelwa — i dzhia niche ine zwiṅwe staples zwa sa kona u i fara zwavhuḓi.
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: Amadumbe really likes damper ground where maize struggles; it takes a niche other staples cannot hold well.
acceptedRows.reason: Really likes does not reliably preserve actually prefers; would becomes present; handle becomes physical hold/take. Preserve source first clause and exact limitation, translate only bounded fill framing.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Amadumbe actually prefers damper ground where maize would struggle — i ḓadza niche ine other staples can't handle well.
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: Why keep a vegetable bed to 1-1.2m wide rather than wider?
acceptedRows.currentTarget: Hikokwalaho ka yini u hlayisa vegetable bed e le 1-1.2m hi ku anama ku ri na ku yi endla yi anama ku tlurisa?
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Hikokwalaho ka yini u hlayisa bed ya miroho yi ri na ku anama ka 1-1.2m, ematshan’weni yo yi endla yi anama ku tlurisa?
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: Why keep vegetable bed1-1.2m wide instead of making it excessively wide?
acceptedRows.reason: Ku tlurisa may mean too/excessively rather than simply wider. Keep exact wider while ordinary bed/width/question framing stays localized.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Hikokwalaho ka yini u hlayisa bed ya miroho yi ri na ku anama ka 1-1.2m, ematshan’weni yo yi endla wider?
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: You can reach the centre from either side without stepping on the growing area, avoiding compaction
acceptedRows.currentTarget: U nga fika exikarhini ku suka eka tlhelo rin'wana ni rin'wana ra lamambirhi handle ko kandziya growing area, u papalata compaction
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: U nga fika exikarhini ku suka eka tlhelo rin’wana ni rin’wana ra lamambirhi handle ko kandziya ndhawu leyi swibyariwa swi milaka eka yona, u papalata compaction.
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: You can reach middle from either of the two sides without treading the place crops grow, avoiding compaction.
acceptedRows.reason: Can/either/without and technical compaction preserved; no new species or quantities.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: U nga fika exikarhini ku suka eka tlhelo rin’wana ni rin’wana ra lamambirhi handle ko kandziya ndhawu leyi swibyariwa swi milaka eka yona, u papalata compaction.
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.

acceptedRows.sourceEnglish: Stepping on growing soil compacts it and damages roots — a bed you can reach into from both sides means you never have to.
acceptedRows.currentTarget: Ku kandziya growing soil ku endla compaction ni ku onha roots — bed leyi u nga yi fikelelaka ku suka ematlhelweni haswimbirhi yi vula leswaku a wu boheki ku kandziya growing soil.
acceptedRows.proposedTarget: Ku kandziya misava leyi swimila swi milaka eka yona swi endla compaction ni ku onha timitsu — bed ya miroho leyi u nga yi fikelelaka ku suka ematlhelweni haswimbirhi yi vula leswaku a wu boheki nikatsongo ku kandziya misava leyi swimila swi milaka eka yona.
acceptedRows.independentBacktranslation: Stepping on growing soil causes compaction and damages roots; a vegetable bed reachable from both sides means you are never obliged to step on the growing soil.
acceptedRows.reason: Soil, roots, both sides and never preserved. Remove unnecessary added vegetable qualifier; source just bed. Keep current reach framing and translate remaining soil/roots.
acceptedRows.recommendedTarget: Ku kandziya misava leyi swimila swi milaka eka yona swi endla compaction ni ku onha timitsu — bed leyi u nga yi fikelelaka ku suka ematlhelweni haswimbirhi yi vula leswaku a wu boheki nikatsongo ku kandziya misava leyi swimila swi milaka eka yona.
acceptedRows.limits: Semantic review with conservative English holds; not fluent-language approval.
